frames.title: Project Tree (shadcn)
frames.notes: Tailwind + shadcn zinc. Sidebar: logo and search on top, Projects group with nested sessions covering needs-approval, running, plan, ready-to-merge, failed, idle and new; collapsed projects keep a summary. Footer: Settings and Collapse sidebar (Cmd+B toggles icon mode). Mode tabs removed; composer has harness/model picker (session override of default). Right panel tabs use GitHub state colors: open green, draft gray, merged purple, closed red, conflict amber.

frames.title: Plan & Approve (variant)
frames.notes: Variant on approved base. Orchestrator only proposes; plan card lists tasks with per-task harness picker, token estimate, Approve & build. Header shows Plan → Approve → Build → Review phase stepper instead of mode tabs.

frames.title: Agent Detail
frames.notes: Opened from a sub-agent card. Transcript with handoff prompt, tool calls, pending permission; right panel shows team fallback chain, context, cost, files, checks.

frames.title: Settings
frames.notes: Detected subscriptions, rule-based team generation with preview, editable teams with ordered fallback chains.
